reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output; the rendered paragraph is unchanged from the original.

Cited Section 12.3 affirmatively preserves Customer's freedom to develop, acquire, license, sell or use any product or service and to operate in any field or territory, and records that no exclusivity/non-compete commitment was given — this meets (indeed exceeds) the preferred position of no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer.

Deterministic check confirms no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains; the rationale correctly characterises the only competition-related provisions (Section 24.2 assignment restriction on Vendor and Section 13.4 acceptable-use terms) as not restraints on our business.
Correctly avoids double-flagging the Section 2.2 exclusivity language, which is properly assessed under the EXCLUSIVITY rule, consistent with the playbook's no-duplicate-flag instruction.
The clause benefits our party, so leaving it untouched is the right call.
